name: Buzzword
description: A quick card to explain an IT strategy or enterprise architecture term out loud.
why: Grasp a concept in seconds and **explain it in an interview**: definition, keywords to drop, well-known products, related concepts.
yes: Preparing an IT or architecture interview
Re-explaining a term heard in a meeting

examples.title: A card
examples.output:
**Enterprise Service Bus (ESB)**
- Conceptually: a **service-oriented architecture (SOA)** pattern.
- Technically: **middleware** that handles **routing**, **orchestration** and **transformation** of data between applications.
- E.g.: TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM App Connect, MuleSoft.
- Buzzwords: `< EAI, < SOA, & API Gateway, = Integration Bus, ≠ ETL`

examples.title: A governance concept
examples.output:
**FinOps (Cloud Financial Management)**
- Conceptually: **financial governance** of the cloud, shared by finance and tech teams.
- Technically: **cost visibility**, **allocation** per team, **optimization** (reservations, rightsizing).
- E.g.: AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, Apptio Cloudability.
- Buzzwords: `< Cloud governance, & Showback, & Chargeback`
